recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated group portrait of three men in white shirts against a dark background, featuring a prominent gold-outlined logo badge and wide-tracked secondary text.
coreVisualRelationships: Bright white clothing against deep black shadows
Staggered vertical arrangement of subjects creating depth
Gold metallic accents contrasting with monochrome photography
Large-scale logo badge anchoring the top corner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects arranged in a diagonal line from bottom left to top right, varying in scale to simulate depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, pill-shaped logo badge in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left logo, moves down through the central faces, and ends at the wide-tracked text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounding the subjects, emphasizing the white shirts.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and charcoal for background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for clothing and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold for typographic outlines and borders.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photography paired with high-value white highlights and high-contrast black shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Interlocking or overlapping characters in the primary logo
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' in the logo features a crossbar that extends to form a border element
Secondary text uses extreme letter spacing (tracking)

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a pill-shaped gold border

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, interlocking display logo paired with a lighter, widely-spaced version of a similar geometric skeleton.
graphicDevices: Pill-shaped container with stepped top edge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, wide geometric skeleton of the 90s era.
Provides the square-off corners and wide stance for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast, desaturated photography of three men in white button-down shirts. The men are arranged in a staggered vertical line against a pitch-black background. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the texture of the white fabric and the contours of their faces. The image should have a slight film grain and a very subtle warm/sepia tint.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large pill-shaped badge in the top left corner with a gold double-line border. Inside, place bold, interlocking uppercase text with gold outlines. At the bottom, place a single line of uppercase text in a wide-tracked, thin gold outline font, spanning the width of the composition.

verificationChecks: Is the photography desaturated with high contrast?
Are the shirts bright white against a black background?
Does the logo have a gold double-line outline?
Is the bottom text widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the gold metallic effect
Tracking width of the bottom text
postGenerationChecks: Check for double-line gold strokes on the main logo.
Ensure the background is deep black without distracting elements.
Verify the white shirts are the brightest part of the image.
Confirm the bottom text is uppercase and widely tracked.
recipe.reuseFormula: Staggered monochrome portrait + Gold outline geometric typography + High-contrast lighting = 90s Urban Aesthetic.
